data.name: AlHafiza
data.gender_notes: AlHafiza is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who has memorized the entire Quran. AlHafiza is a title of respect and honor for those who have dedicated their lives to preserving the sacred words of Allah. The name AlHafiza carries the meaning “The Preserver” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlHafiza usually hope their child will grow to embody the preserver and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Honoring the Quran and the preservation of its knowledge.
data.etymology: AlHafiza belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Preserver.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlHafiza total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_english.name: AlHafiza
in_english.meaning: Protector of the faith, Preserver of the guidance, Guardian of the righteous
in_english.long_meaning: AlHafiza is one of the names of Allah in the Quran, which means the Protector of the faith, Preserver of the guidance, and Guardian of the righteous. This name highlights Allah's power to protect and preserve the guidance, and His wisdom in distributing the protectorship to His servants. AlHafiza is also associated with the concept of protection and preservation, which is essential for the well-being of humanity. This name emphasizes Allah's role in protecting and preserving the faith, and His ability to guide His servants towards righteousness.
